steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:3000/ in the browser. Then click Back/Close the panel editor and SAVE the dashboard with the title exactly '{{runid}} {{01-open.dashboard_folder}} Dashboard' (choose a folder if asked, e.g. {{01-open.dashboard_folder}} or General).
